# TEAM CODE (integration: team) - the team's shared host-test build, adapted from the ZEIT4230 PD5 Host-Side Testing Guide (Appendix A/B); not generated by STM32CubeMX.
# Origin: PD5b_Jack/README.md (adapted from the course guide), PD5b_Brendon/README.md and the team-standard shared file of 19 Aug 2026; how much differs from the course original is not recorded.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)

project(PD5HostTests LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)

include(CTest)

# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Application code: real hardware-independent code.
# --------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB_RECURSE APP_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Application/*.c"
)

if(NOT APP_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No application .c files found under Application/")
endif()

add_library(application STATIC ${APP_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(application
    PUBLIC
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Application"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Interfaces"
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Unity: vendored into Tests/Unity.
# Also picks up fixture/memory .c files if added later.
# --------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB UNITY_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Tests/Unity/*.c"
)

if(NOT UNITY_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No Unity .c files found under Tests/Unity/")
endif()

add_library(unity STATIC ${UNITY_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(unity
    PUBLIC
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Tests/Unity"
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Test doubles: host replacements for hardware/dependencies.
# --------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB_RECURSE DOUBLE_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Tests/Doubles/*.c"
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Each top-level Tests/test_*.c becomes its own executable.
# Each test file contains its own main().
# --------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB TEST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Tests/test_*.c"
)

if(NOT TEST_SOURCES)
    message(WARNING "No Tests/test_*.c files found; CTest will have no tests")
endif()

foreach(TEST_SOURCE IN LISTS TEST_SOURCES)
    get_filename_component(TEST_NAME "${TEST_SOURCE}" NAME_WE)

    add_executable(${TEST_NAME}
        ${TEST_SOURCE}
        ${DOUBLE_SOURCES}
    )

    target_include_directories(${TEST_NAME}
        PRIVATE
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Tests/Doubles"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Interfaces"
    )

    target_link_libraries(${TEST_NAME}
        PRIVATE
            application
            unity
    )

    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "AppleClang|Clang|GNU")
        target_compile_options(${TEST_NAME} PRIVATE
            -Wall
            -Wextra
            -Wpedantic
        )
    endif()

    add_test(NAME ${TEST_NAME} COMMAND ${TEST_NAME})
endforeach()
